title: SourceDocument
description: One local source document about the entity under profile. Each fixture file contains exactly one of these objects.

id.description: Stable identifier for this source, unique within a fixture case. Claims cite this value.

date.description: Publication date of the source, ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).

title.description: Human-readable title, shown by the renderer next to citations.

text.description: Full body text of the source. Quote spans in claims must appear verbatim (exact substring) in this field.

notes.description: Optional author notes about why this fixture exists (e.g. 'plants a conflicting founding date'). Never shown to the model or the renderer.
